notes:
Account summary:
- Target: private VPC deployment (customer-managed VPC) for production inference across chat + embeddings + risk scorer. Must meet strict data residency for US financial data and audit requirements.
- Primary driver: replace ad-hoc self-hosted clusters; reduce ops cost while satisfying compliance.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (Avery) — high level product fit, confirmed interest in Private.
- 2026-01-25: Security questionnaire (SQ) submitted — vault+infra team. Most items answered; KMS flows need diagram. (drive link).
- 2026-02-10: Architecture workshop w/ SE (Maya) — discussed VPC topology, egress patterns, and control plane reachability. Action: provide explicit inbound/outbound rule set.
- 2026-02-18: Fireflies transcript + 30m follow-up (ff_20260302_9b4c2a) — product + security present.
- 2026-03-02: KMS PoC kicked off in dev account; initial key wrap/unwrap tests passed; audit log forwarding to Splunk in progress. Ticket RDW-4321 opened for log format.

Requirements / constraints (concise):
- VPC topology: private subnets for inference nodes, isolated management subnets for control-plane proxies; NAT egress preferred via customer NAT GW; no public IPs on inference instances.
- Inbound: only from customer-app-tier CIDR through ALB + internal NLB; Strict security groups; port whitelist for TLS (443) and health endpoints.
- Outbound: limited to Redwood control plane endpoints (TLS) + S3 endpoints for model artifacts; require explicit IP list and FQDN allowlist.
- Regions: initially us-east-1 primary, plan EU secondary (eu-west-1) for EU customers; data residency required for US-data stays in US.
- KMS: customer-managed CMK in AWS KMS; key policy must allow Redwood agent role for encrypt/decrypt; need sample IAM policy.
- Audit logging: all inference request metadata and operator actions must forward to customer Splunk/CloudWatch with retention of 7 years; include content redaction requirements (no PII persisted).
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II required; ISO27001 desirable. SSO via SAML enforced.

Model + perf targets:
- Workloads: chat (p95 latency target 120ms token-step), embeddings (100 qps target), risk scorer (batch reranking 500 reqs/min).
- Models: prefer Redwood-verified Llama2-style 70B quantized for accuracy; fallback to 13B quantized for burst/cheap tier. Embeddings: open-text-embedding-3 equivalent.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high — willing to pay for dedicated nodes if SLA guarantees throughput.

POC milestones and acceptance criteria:
- Stage 1 (POC infra): deploy Private agent into dev VPC, verify KMS integration and audit forwarding (target: 2 weeks).
- Stage 2 (performance): run 48h perf run with 2k concurrent chat sessions, verify p95 latency < target, measure token cost.
- Stage 3 (security sign-off): pass internal security review + legal sign-off on SLA and data residency clauses.

- "Need concrete network rules we can hand to infra for whitelisting." — Platform Ops
